title: Ledger Record
description: One ledger row — spec §10 verbatim field list: {ticker, date, stage, route(A/B/Peak/lens), verdict, confidence(0–1), key_evidence:[{claim,label,source,as_of}], falsifiers:[{observable,threshold,check_date}], size_or_shadow, source_channel, coverage_class, system_version, skill_versions, model_ids, next_check} plus outcome columns per position/shadow entry (marks at 6/12/24/36 months vs benchmark, reason-match). Every stage emits one record; nothing counts unless logged with versions attached — unlogged = doesn't exist (Constitution rule 11). Validation runs in code before handoff; the record is written only by the separate insert-only logger, which holds no web tools (week one: Vyom pasting the validated JSON himself). Research contexts never possess the write key (spec §10, §12). See spec/investment-os-v3.2-master-spec.md §10.

ticker.description: Ticker this record concerns, matching the inbox row that supplied it.

date.description: Date this record was emitted, ISO 8601.

stage.description: Pipeline stage that emitted this record (spec §4, legacy IDs in brackets): discovery [S1A], verify [S1B], triage [S2], evidence_lock [S3], underwrite [S4], redteam [S5], synthesis [S6/S9], portfolio_gate [U6], log, maintenance [S16], results [S8], calibrate [S15].

route.description: Route at the time of this record (spec §3, §10: route A/B/Peak/lens). null only for records emitted before Triage [S2] has assigned a route (e.g. discovery capture, verify-stage kills).

verdict.description: The stage's verdict in that stage's own vocabulary (e.g. route/kill at triage; hold/add/exit at maintenance vs pre-registered criteria; held/failed at results). Spec §10 fixes the field; each stage's skill defines its values.

confidence.description: Stated confidence in the verdict, 0–1 (spec §10). Pre-registered; scored by Brier in Loop 2 (spec §11) — Vyom's and Claude's confidences are scored separately.

key_evidence.description: Key evidence behind the verdict: {claim, label, source, as_of} per spec §10, carrying the §2 labelling discipline into the ledger. May be empty only for stages with no evidentiary content yet (e.g. discovery capture).

claim.description: The claim, stated plainly; where it comes from a locked evidence pack, prefix or reference the pack claim ID.

as_of.description: As-of date of the underlying fact, ISO 8601 (spec §2.4).

falsifiers.description: Pre-registered falsifiers: {observable, threshold, check_date} per spec §10. Written by Vyom at synthesis — no position, real or shadow, exists without them (Constitution rule 8). A triggered falsifier forces a logged review within 7 days, before any trade (spec §4 Maintenance; Constitution rule 9). Empty for stages before falsifiers exist.

observable.description: What is watched — a specific, checkable observable (e.g. cash conversion, leverage, a permit's continuity).

threshold.description: The pre-registered level or condition that triggers review; a string when units or wording matter (e.g. '85% cash conversion'), a number when bare.

check_date.description: Date the observable is next checked, ISO 8601.

size_or_shadow.description: Position size if entered — set by Vyom alone, within the §9 caps, before entry — or a shadow-book marker for names logged unbought (spec §10 shadow book rule: every name surviving the full pipeline is logged, bought or not; target ≥20 scored decisions/year). This field records Vyom's decision; the system never computes or triggers an order.

system_version.description: Master-spec version that produced this record (e.g. 3.2.0). Ledger rows always record the versions that produced them, so outcome changes are attributable to system changes (spec §16).

additionalProperties.description: Version of that skill's SKILL.md as run.

skill_versions.description: Map from skill name as registered in spec §14 (e.g. /triage, /lock, /underwrite-b) to the SKILL.md version that ran. Nothing counts unless logged with skill versions attached (Constitution rule 11); Loop 1 reruns on any version change (spec §16).

model_ids.description: Exact model identifiers that served this record's contexts, recorded verbatim for attribution (spec §10, §16). Tier labels alone (fast/standard/strong) are not sufficient here — the ledger records concrete IDs so that outcome changes remain attributable to model changes.

next_check.description: Next scheduled check date, ISO 8601 — drives Maintenance [S16] falsifier monitoring and alert setting for the swing (spec §13). null only for terminal records with nothing left to monitor.

outcome.description: Outcome columns per position/shadow entry (spec §10): mark at 6/12/24/36 months vs benchmark, plus reason-match. Marks are null or omitted until due — the first edge-claim test date is January 2027 (spec §11); until benchmark-adjusted ledger data exists the system's edge is unproven (Constitution rule 12).

mark_6m.description: 6-month mark vs benchmark; null/omitted until due.

mark_12m.description: 12-month mark vs benchmark; null/omitted until due. Also feeds per-channel scoring (spec §5: leads → triage survival → shadow-book entries → 12-month result vs benchmark).

mark_24m.description: 24-month mark vs benchmark; null/omitted until due.

mark_36m.description: 36-month mark vs benchmark; null/omitted until due.

reason_match.description: Did it succeed/fail for the pre-registered reason (spec §10)? pending = not yet resolvable; matched = succeeded for the stated reason; right_for_wrong_reason = a right answer for the wrong reason — scores as luck; failed_for_stated_reason = the pre-registered risk killed it; failed_for_other_reason = failed for something not pre-registered. Resolved by /results against the pre-registered thesis; audited quarterly in Loop 2 (spec §11).

coverage_class.description: Coverage class declared for the retrieval run (spec §2.1). C0 = user-supplied evidence set; C1 = enumerated universe (full roster/feed, every row processed); C2 = bounded-source harvest — never 'all qualifying companies'; C3 = open-web scout, non-exhaustive sample only, never proof of absence. Dynamic, blocked, paywalled, or truncated sources downgrade the class; more searching never upgrades C2/C3 to C1. All Lane-2 sweeps are C2 unless run against an enumerated feed. Shared enum — identical across all schemas in schemas/; changes only by versioned edit (spec §16).

evidence_label.description: Evidence label (spec §2.2). FACT = cited source; CALC = deterministic from cited inputs, formula shown; EST = analyst assumption, basis and sensitivity shown; INFERENCE = interpretation; NOT_FOUND = acceptable answer (a plausible invented number is not); CONFLICT = credible sources disagree, recency/scope/restatement explained. Shared enum — identical across all schemas in schemas/; changes only by versioned edit (spec §16).

route.description: Route assigned by the two-axis router (spec §3). A = Playbook A durability (§6.1); B = Playbook B reversion (§6.2); Peak = elevated/peak earnings — default pass, logged with reason 'peak-earnings cheapness'; lens-* = specialist lenses (§6.3): bio/clinical binary, explorer/developer, special situation/cash shell, distressed capital structure, financials/credit, resources producer (B-core method), pre-profit software/tech. Lenses are method vocabularies, not exclusive routes — this field records the primary route (a bank in a credit panic is B with the Financials lens vocabulary). Shared enum — identical across all schemas in schemas/; changes only by versioned edit (spec §16).

source_channel.description: Discovery stream that supplied the name (spec §5). Claude never originates tickers from memory — every lead carries this tag. lane1_bench_alert = Lane 1 bench price alert; ch1–ch8 = Lane 2 event-scanner channels (index deletions, insider clusters, capital-cycle signals, multi-year lows ∩ survivability, special situations, filing deltas, activist/substantial holders, tax-loss windows); lane3_human = Lane 3 human flow (forums supply tickers, never theses); vyom_direct = supplied directly by Vyom. Feeds quarterly channel scoring; weights may not change until four quarters of scored data exist. Shared enum — identical across all schemas in schemas/; changes only by versioned edit (spec §16).

benchmark_mark.description: One outcome mark vs benchmark (spec §10); null until the mark is due.

position_return.description: Position (or shadow entry) total return over the mark window, decimal fraction (0.12 = +12%). Computed in code, not in prose (Constitution rule 6).

benchmark_return.description: Benchmark total return over the same window, decimal fraction.

benchmark_name.description: Benchmark used for scoring (spec §10): S&P/ASX 300 accumulation (AU sleeve); S&P 500 total return plus an energy/materials index (US sleeve); money-weighted.

as_of.description: Date the mark was taken, ISO 8601.
